description: This file defines classes and functions for uploading PyTorch benchmark data in pytest-benchmark format to a logging service using Scribe. It includes a base uploader class and a specialized subclass for PyTorch benchmarks, with methods for formatting messages, uploading via internal or external endpoints, and processing benchmark JSON data.

classes.name: ScribeUploader
classes.description: Base class for uploading log messages to a Scribe endpoint, supporting internal subprocess or Facebook Graph API.

classes.name: PytorchBenchmarkUploader
classes.description: Subclass of ScribeUploader tailored for uploading PyTorch benchmark data with a predefined schema.

methods.name: format_message
methods.description: Formats a dictionary of fields into a structured message with type-specific categories.

methods.name: _upload_intern
methods.description: Uploads messages using a subprocess call to 'scribe_cat'.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads messages either via internal subprocess or external Facebook Graph API, depending on environment variables.

methods.name: post_pytest_benchmarks
methods.description: Processes pytest-benchmark JSON data and uploads benchmark metrics with associated metadata.
